commands.guardians.leave: Leave the arena (counts as a wipe).
message.guardians.arena.guardian_did_not: The guardian did not answer. The totem is spent.
message.guardians.arena.nobody_stands_to: Nobody stands. The totem is spent.
message.guardians.arena.stage_stood_empt: The stage stood empty too long. The totem is spent.
message.guardians.arena.guardian_slipped: The guardian slipped the weave. The totem is spent.
message.guardians.arena.clowder_withdrew: The Clowder withdrew. The totem is spent.
message.guardians.beddown.beddown_answer: The Beddown answers for the Cut. When it slams and the soil rises, dig for the seam that glows.
message.guardians.beddown.beddown_rears_: The Beddown rears up... the ground is coming.
message.guardians.beddown.soil_floods_pi: The soil floods the pit. Find the seam that glows and break the root core!
message.guardians.beddown.root_core_crac: The root core cracks. The Beddown heaves up through the soil!
message.guardians.beddown.soil_settles_o: The soil settles on its own...
message.guardians.beddown.beddown_sleeps: The Beddown sleeps under the soil. Dig to the glowing seam and break its root core.
message.guardians.cogwright.cogwright_an: The Cogwright answers for the Cut. It winds a pattern into the rings: watch which tiles light and in what order, then walk them in that order before the escapement runs out. Get it wrong and every gear-tower arcs.
message.guardians.cogwright.pendulum_swi: The pendulum swings back — the rings reverse.
message.guardians.cogwright.cogwright_wi: The Cogwright winds... watch the tiles.
message.guardians.cogwright.now_walk_til: Now — walk the tiles in that order. Twelve seconds.
message.guardians.cogwright.pattern_hold: The pattern holds — the Cogwright's chassis opens! Strike!
message.guardians.cogwright.cogwright_s_: The Cogwright's chassis is shut. Step the lit tiles in the order it wound them.
message.guardians.drumheart.drumheart_an: The Drumheart answers for the Cut. Listen: three beats, then the downbeat. It opens only on the fourth. Stand on an amber pad as the fourth beat lands to charge a spark, and mind the hammers and the lava lines.
message.guardians.drumheart.drumheart_on: The Drumheart only opens on its fourth beat. Strike on the downbeat.
message.guardians.edgewalker.edgewalker_: The Edgewalker answers for the Cut. No trick to this one: watch for the gold claw-mark and be somewhere else when it lands. Bridges crumble behind you.
The Edgewalker bares every claw — it pounces without pause!
message.guardians.firstcut.first_cut_ans: The First Cut answers for nothing — it made the Cut. When it raises the blade, the red line is where the floor stops existing. The gold seam is fast, and the seam is where its beam runs.
message.guardians.firstcut.beam_gathers_: The beam gathers along the seam.
message.guardians.firstcut.world_shards_: The world-shards begin to collide with the floor. Red rings are crush zones.
message.guardians.firstcut.void_tears_op: The void tears open — teal lines lift whoever stands on them.
message.guardians.firstcut.main_shard_sp: The main shard splits along the Cut! The halves drift apart — jump while you still can.
message.guardians.firstcut.first_cut_rai: The First Cut raises the blade...
message.guardians.firstcut.severed_floor: SEVERED. The floor along the line is gone for fifteen seconds.
message.guardians.grindmaw.grindmaw_answ: The Grindmaw answers for the Cut. Its maw only opens for its own grit: take a chute's grit block, set it on the grindstone ring and let the ring carry it into the gold-lit mouth.
message.guardians.grindmaw.sieve_chutes_: The sieve chutes pour fresh grit.
message.guardians.grindmaw.grit_gears_gr: Grit in the gears! The Grindmaw's maw is jammed open — strike now!
message.guardians.grindmaw.grindmaw_s_ma: The Grindmaw's maw is shut. Ride sieve grit round the grindstone into its mouth.
message.guardians.hivemind.hivemind_answ: The Hivemind answers for the Cut. The queen is soft, but her six drone cells in the wall never stop pouring. Set a lit campfire at a cell to smoke it shut; smoke all six and the royal chamber opens.
message.guardians.hivemind.royal_chamber: The royal chamber gapes open on its own — strike the queen!
message.guardians.hivemind.hivemind_shri: The Hivemind shrieks — every cell empties at once!
message.guardians.hivemind.comb_hums_lou: The comb hums louder. More drones.
message.guardians.hivemind.all_six_cells: All six cells are smoked — the royal chamber opens! Strike the queen!
message.guardians.hivemind.royal_chamber: The royal chamber is shut. Smoke all six drone cells with lit campfires.
message.guardians.lintgolem.lint_golem_a: The Lint Golem answers for the Cut... sort of. It throws lint, it hides behind the washing, and it cannot hurt you. Stomp the red rug to make it sneeze, then hit it while it reels.
message.guardians.lintgolem.lint_golem_s: The Lint Golem sheds a little. It throws faster.
message.guardians.lintgolem.lint_golem_t: The Lint Golem throws with both hands!
message.guardians.lintgolem.lint_golem_c: The Lint Golem is coming apart in tufts — mind the puff!
message.guardians.overweaver.overweaver_: The Overweaver answers for the Cut with every guardian you have broken. It throws their shades onto the nine strands; each shade you kill pulls a thread taut for 25 s, and only then can the loom itself be hurt.
The Overweaver throws three shades at once!
message.guardians.overweaver.all_nine_st: All nine strands at once — and the keystone descends. When it settles, only blows from beneath it land.
message.guardians.overweaver.no_thread_t: No thread is taut. Kill a shade on its strand-platform to pull one tight.
message.guardians.sealbreaker.sealbreake: The Sealbreaker's wards flicker — it is exposed for twelve seconds!

The Sealbreaker answers for the Cut. Three wards hold it: teal-lit ward-glass at the foot of three pillars. Don't rush them — the dais pegs light the order. Dispel the glass in that order; break the wrong one and the whole circle bites.
The Sealbreaker raises a fourth ward — a decoy. Only three are written on the dais.
message.guardians.sealbreaker.runes_shuf: The runes shuffle! Watch the dais again.
message.guardians.sealbreaker.wards_fall: The wards fall — the Sealbreaker is exposed! Twelve seconds.
message.guardians.sealbreaker.wrong_ward: Wrong ward! The circle bites and every ward re-arms.
message.guardians.sealbreaker.sealbreake: The Sealbreaker hides behind its wards. Watch the dais pegs and dispel the wards in that order.
message.guardians.tangle.tangle_answers_: The Tangle answers for the Cut. It strings the paths shut behind you — cut the knots — and it hunts whoever wanders off alone. Stay together.
message.guardians.tangle.tangle_spits_kn: The Tangle spits knots — watch the line at your feet.
message.guardians.tangle.knotlings_skitt: Knotlings skitter out of the hedge!
message.guardians.thornmother.thornmothe: The Thornmother answers for the Cut. She will not strike you — her hedge will. Cut it faster than it creeps, keep the four pruning stations clear, and every eight thorns you cut fire a prune wave that stuns her.
The Thornmother strains — the hedge grows wild!
message.guardians.thornmother.pruning_st: A pruning station is choked — the Thornmother drinks from it and heals!
message.guardians.unwoven.unwoven_answer: The Unwoven answers for the Cut — and it remembers every guardian you broke. Each phase it quotes two of them; then a heddle bar drops and the loom floor unravels beneath you.
message.guardians.unwoven.soil_heaves_ar: Soil heaves around the Unwoven — dig to the glowing core.
message.guardians.unwoven.grit_rattles_d: Grit rattles down — place gravel at its feet to jam the maw.
message.guardians.unwoven.thorns_creep_c: Thorns creep in — cut them or it drinks from them.
message.guardians.unwoven.lashes_like_ed: It lashes like the Edgewalker — leave the gold mark.
message.guardians.unwoven.beats_like_dru: It beats like the Drumheart — strike on the fourth.
message.guardians.unwoven.tiles_light_li: Tiles light like the Cogwright's — walk them in order.
message.guardians.unwoven.wards_rise_lik: Wards rise like the Sealbreaker's — watch the lights, then break the glass in that order.
message.guardians.unwoven.core_cracks_op: The core cracks — it is open!
message.guardians.unwoven.grit_gears_maw: Grit in the gears — the maw jams open!
message.guardians.unwoven.wrong_tile_gea: Wrong tile! The gears arc — the pattern is lost.
message.guardians.unwoven.wards_fall_exp: The wards fall — it is exposed!
message.guardians.unwoven.heddle_bar_dro: A heddle bar drops — the warp unravels!
message.guardians.unwoven.unwoven_unrave: The Unwoven unravels into its true form and climbs to the top beam. The warp threads pull taut — climb them and finish it on the beam!
message.guardians.relic.no_soil_for_hedg: No soil for the hedge here, but the sap still runs.
message.guardians.relic.rootheart.active: Root Down: root yourself for 5 s with 8 hearts of absorption, no fall damage, and Slowness II on anything that hits you. Sneak to cancel.
message.guardians.relic.grindcore.passiv: Grit: immune to Mining Fatigue; your hand sieves get one extra fortune roll.
message.guardians.relic.grindcore.active: Shred: your next melee hit within 6 s strips 2 armour from the target for 8 s.
message.guardians.relic.thornseed.passiv: Bramble Skin: attackers take 1 heart; immune to berry-bush and cactus damage.
message.guardians.relic.thornseed.active: Bloom: grow a ring of thorn hedge around you for 20 s and give you and mates inside it Regeneration II for 6 s.
message.guardians.relic.edgestep.passive: Cat's Landing: no fall damage from 12 blocks or less.
message.guardians.relic.edgestep.active: Edgestep: dash 6 blocks the way you look (works in the air), 0.3 s of i-frames, and +50 %% damage on a hit right after. Two charges.
message.guardians.relic.drumpulse.passiv: On the Beat: every 4th hit you land deals +2 hearts.
message.guardians.relic.drumpulse.active: Downbeat: stun every mob within 7 blocks for 2 s and knock them back.
message.guardians.relic.cogloop.passive: Wound Tight: Haste I while worn.
message.guardians.relic.cogloop.active: Rewind: reset the cooldown of every other relic you carry, refill Edgestep, and blink back to where you stood 3 s ago.
message.guardians.relic.hivecall.passive: Keeper: bees never hurt you; hives within 16 blocks work 10 %% faster.
message.guardians.relic.hivecall.active: Call the Swarm: four relic-bees for 20 s that harass whatever you hit (Poison I on sting) and pop into a honey bottle each.
message.guardians.relic.sealmark.active: Sealmark: ward yourself (or the mate you look at, within 8 blocks): the next hit of 3 hearts or more is negated. Lasts 20 s.
message.guardians.relic.loomthread.passi: Re-woven: +1 heart max health per two Strands your Clowder has tensioned (up to +4).
message.guardians.relic.loomthread.activ: Loomthread: reel every Clowder-mate within 24 blocks to your side and give everyone Resistance I for 5 s.
message.guardians.relic.lintwisp.passive: Soft: immune to cactus, berry-bush and thorn-hedge damage.
message.guardians.relic.lintwisp.active: Puff: a harmless cloud of lint that blinds every mob within 5 blocks for 4 s.
message.guardians.relic.knotcharm.passiv: Sure-footed: no slowdown on soul sand or honey, a burst of speed through cobwebs and powder snow, never freezes.
message.guardians.relic.knotcharm.active: Tangle: throw a knot up to 12 blocks; the first mob hit is rooted for 4 s (it can still attack).
message.guardians.relic.firstcut_shard.p: Severed: your melee hits ignore 30 %% of armour and cut through Guardian ward phases for 25 %% damage.
message.guardians.relic.firstcut_shard.a: The Cut: slash a 6-block line ahead; every mob in it takes 12 hearts of true damage and boss projectiles in it are cut apart.
message.guardians.relic.overweaver_shutt: Nine Strands: knockback -30 %%, Thorns, Haste I, magic -10 %%, bees ignore you, safe falls to 8 blocks, sure-footed, thorn-proof.
Reweave: for 10 s every Clowder-mate within 16 blocks shares your buffs and takes 20 %% less damage; a downed mate in range is revived at half health, once.
message.guardians.arena.spent_life_canno: A spent life cannot call a guardian.
message.guardians.arena.already_answerin: You are already answering for the Cut.
message.guardians.arena.clowder_already_: Your Clowder is already in an arena.
message.guardians.arena.not_woven: The arena is not woven into this world (dimension missing).
message.guardians.arena.door_after_rewea: That door only opens after the Reweave.
message.guardians.arena.seat_strand_firs: Seat the %s Strand at your Tension Post first — %s only answers for a Strand that is held.
message.guardians.arena.totem_calls: The Frayed Totem calls %s to answer for the Cut.
message.guardians.arena.prove_worthiness: Prove worthiness. Fall, and the totem is spent.
message.guardians.arena.drops_came_home: What you dropped on the stage came home with you.
message.guardians.arena.loom_pulls_back: The Loom pulls you back onto the stage.
message.guardians.arena.worthy_gate_open: Worthy. The gate opens; you will be returned shortly.
message.guardians.totem.mates_answer: Clowder mates within 32 blocks answer with you.
message.guardians.drumheart.spark_charge: Spark charged — hit it on the next open beat!
message.guardians.drumheart.quickens: The Drumheart quickens — %s beats a minute.
message.guardians.firstcut.void_tear_pul: A void tear pulls you up!
message.guardians.grindmaw.grit_pit_grin: The grit pit grinds at you.
message.guardians.grindmaw.grindstone_re: The grindstone reverses! The maw turns to %s.
message.guardians.lintgolem.beats_rug: %s beats the rug — the Lint Golem sneezes and reels! Hit it now (double damage).
message.guardians.overweaver.keystone_do: The keystone has come down — strike from beneath it.
message.guardians.overweaver.throws_shad: The Overweaver throws the shade of %s onto its strand.
message.guardians.overweaver.shade_unrav: The shade of %s unravels — its thread pulls taut! The loom can be hurt for 25 s.
message.guardians.tangle.venom_alone: Alone in a dead end — the Tangle's venom bites deep.
message.guardians.tangle.caught_scent: The Tangle has caught your scent — you are alone.
message.guardians.hivemind.cell_smoked: A drone cell is smoked shut (%s/%s).
message.guardians.unwoven.frays_further: The Unwoven frays further. It remembers %s and %s.
message.guardians.unwoven.immune_buried: Buried. Dig to the glowing core and break it.
message.guardians.unwoven.immune_grit: Its maw is shut. Place gravel at its feet.
message.guardians.unwoven.immune_beat: It opens only on its fourth beat.
message.guardians.unwoven.immune_pattern: Walk the lit tiles in the order they lit.
message.guardians.unwoven.immune_wards: Dispel the ward-glass in the order the lights showed.
message.guardians.cogwright.rewinds: The Cogwright re-winds — the pattern grows to %s tiles.
message.guardians.thornmother.prune_wave: Prune wave! %s thorns wither and the Thornmother reels — strike her now!
